message.content:
This is a CBP ruling on empty server racks. Empty steel cabinets for computer servers are generally classified in 9403.20.0090 (other metal furniture) or 8473.30 (parts of ADP machines). I recall CBP rulings on server racks and enclosures classifying them as 9403.20.0090, and on electrical enclosures as 8538.10.0000 (boards, panels, consoles, cabinets and other bases for apparatus of 8535/8536/8537, not equipped). This cabinet holds power-distribution units, busbars and switching devices, but it is mainly a server rack that houses computer equipment. Recent rulings (e.g., NY N3xxxxx for Microsoft racks) classified such cabinets in 8538.10.0000, since they are designed to house electrical apparatus. Because the description emphasizes power distribution, busbars and switching devices, and the rack is designed for multiple kinds of equipment, I'm going with 8538.10.0000, though it is a close call against 9403.20.0090. The HTS statistical suffix for 8538.10 is 8538.10.0000.

{"hts_code": "8538.10.0000", "reason": "Empty, unequipped steel cabinet with mounting rails and grounding, designed to house power-distribution units, busbars and switching devices, is classified as a cabinet/base for electrical apparatus of heading 8537 under 8538.10."}
